recommendation: Keep the current source and this audit commit. Do not re-apply FHIR-20804's R5 calculated wording to the current build unless CQI makes a new decision that supersedes FHIR-41018.
issue_request: FHIR-20804 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core MeasureReport clarification for R5 asking to resolve ambiguity in MeasureReport.date by changing the description from report generation timing to the date the measure was calculated.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by commit e62ab8df772ec147612cd8c36a9b1ebd4071ae56 and PR HL7/fhir#2879, which changed source/measurereport/structuredefinition-MeasureReport.xml so MeasureReport.date said the measure was calculated.
additional_context: FHIR-40797 later documented that the R5 calculated wording was misleading in DEQM and pointed back to FHIR-20804. FHIR-41018, an Applied/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core issue for R6, intentionally changed MeasureReport.date back to report generation timing and added MeasureReport.group.calculatedDate for calculation timing.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini lists MeasureReport and MeasureReport.group.calculatedDate as active, and the current StructureDefinition already says MeasureReport.date is when the measure report was generated while group.calculatedDate records the calculation date.

related_jiras.note: DEQM follow-up that documented the generated-versus-calculated ambiguity and linked back to FHIR-20804.
Later Applied FHIR-core decision that reverted MeasureReport.date to generated and added MeasureReport.group.calculatedDate.
